label: Desirable-insofar-as-perfect gives its forward half
meaning: Strength registration (not a route step): the per-perfection biconditional 'desirable in p exactly when perfect in p' gives its forward half 'perfect in p implies desirable in p'. Controls rows 3 and 4 satisfy the forward half and not the biconditional.
